text.p: Emery Worldwide's volumes in Mexico are running 40 percent better than last year, a top Emery executive said Wednesday.

"We're very pleased with our business. We're up 40 percent over last year. There is a lot of optimism in the latest quarter," Ron Young, Emery's vice president for Latin American said in an interview.

Reflecting Mexico's recovery since its 1994 economic crisis, Latin Trade magazine reported Mexico's gross domestic product increased 7.2 percent in the second quarter compared with the year earlier quarter.
Although Emery operates as a forwarder in the rest of Latin America, it flies four times per week from its Dayton, Ohio, hub to Mexico City and twice to Guadalajara.
Emery, based in Redwood City, Ca., is a unit of Palo Alto-based Consolidated Freightways Inc. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
